speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me, aside from the fatigue, bruising, fever, and leg pain you mentioned, do you notice any swollen or tender lymph nodes, or have you experienced any bone pain in your chest or abdomen?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL).

The constellation of fatigue, easy bruising, fever, and severe bone pain (specifically in the legs) in a 4-year-old is highly suggestive of ALL. I will now request a CBC with differential and a peripheral blood smear to confirm the presence of blast cells.
